mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window or 20-day forward returns are negative in >55% of periods with declining FEDFUNDS.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.5% and remains elevated for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in >55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broad-based consumer demand weakness that reduces corporate revenue growth, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for HOUST-RSAFS interaction < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window or 60-day returns positive in >55% of joint decline instances.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average signals manufacturing sector weakness that reduces corporate profit growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion, 20-day returns positive in >55% of INDPRO decline instances or Rank IC < 0.03 in regime.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) over the past quarter indicates strong economic growth that boosts corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for GDPC1 < 0.05 over 5-year window or 5-day returns negative in >55% of growth periods.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0% for three consecutive months, it signals accelerating inflation that prompts monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns positive in >55% of CPIAUCSL >3.0% periods or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates labor market deterioration that reduces consumer confidence and spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for PAYEMS-UNRATE interaction < 0.03 over 3-year window or 60-day returns positive in >55% of joint signal instances.

mechanism_narrative: During housing market recovery, a rise in housing starts (HOUST) above its 6-month moving average signals increased consumer confidence and spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In housing recovery regime, 5-day returns negative in >55% of HOUST >6-month MA instances or Rank IC < 0.03 in regime.
